description: You are investigating a pricing bug in src/utils/pricing.js where premium discounts are 15% instead of expected 20%. Git blame shows 'Intern Sam - Ran Prettier on entire codebase' for all lines, hiding the real author. Your task: (1) Create a .git-blame-ignore-revs file in the project root, (2) Add the commit hashes of formatting commits (look for commits with messages like 'ESLint auto-fix' and 'Ran Prettier') to this file, (3) Optionally run 'git config blame.ignoreRevsFile .git-blame-ignore-revs', (4) Use git blame again to find who actually changed the discount logic, (5) Create a file named INVESTIGATION_REPORT.txt documenting who made the real business logic change to the calculateDiscount function, their commit hash, and how you bypassed the formatting commits. The workspace is at /home/ga/workspace/ecommerce-site
